messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert: API reachability degraded (US-WEST). Multiple 525/520 from CDN edges, elevated 5xx for /v1/generate. Pager sent to rotation-sre and ashwin.

ashwin: seeing it — good catch. initial check: origin healthy, no deploys. spikes started ~14:12 UTC.

maria: confirmed on support side, several customers reporting timeout/connection refused in us-west. Support ticket count rising.

ashwin: observability? can we get POP-level breakdown?

observa-bot: metrics alert: api.gateway.errors(5xx) > 30% in us-west-1 region, spike started 2024-03-04T14:12:05Z. Top error class: TLS handshake failures (525) reported from CF POPs: iad, lga, sjc.

ashwin: run quick curl from our jumpbox to several CF endpoints.

maria: pasting curl from bastion -> cf-pop 198.51.100.23:
```
$ curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/health -o /dev/null -s -w "%{http_code}\n"
* Connected to api.redwood-inference.com (198.51.100.23) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake: ALERT: Handshake failure
* Closing connection 0
525
```

ashwin: same. logs show `TLS alert handshake_failure` from several CF edge IPs. origin TLS cert valid, handshake works directly to origin from our net. suggests edge->origin or edge SNI issue.

tim: support: ~47 active tickets, knobs: big customers A & B are affected, enterprise usage dropping to errors. CS alerted.

ashwin: hypothesis: Cloudflare edge config or SNI propagation problem for certain POPs. reaching out to CF via support link; I'll open a ticket and attach logs.

jess: add customer-impact header in incident page, please. we need ETA estimates for customers.

ashwin: created CF ticket 987654 — included TLS logs and sample traces. CF acknowledged and assigned to Tier2. they report anomaly in SNI routing rules deployed ~14:05 UTC and rollback in progress.

rotation-sre: meanwhile we should enable mitigation path: plan options:
1) DNS failover to secondary-cdn (weighted -> 0.1 primary) via provider API (low TTL).
2) Enable origin bypass for critical routes to allow clients to hit our origin directly (HTTP(S) allowlist) — risk: capacity and WAF differences.
3) Route affected customer IP ranges to EU edges using traffic steering (if supported).

maria: support prefers minimal config change. do we have a DNS failover ready?

ashwin: yes we have a pre-configured secondary-cdn pool in DNS provider. I'll swing the weight and lower TTL. doing step now.

ashwin: running command: `dnsctl set-weight api.redwood-inference.com --pool primary=50 --pool secondary=50 --ttl 30`

observa-bot: DNS change propagated to ~30% of resolvers within 90s. early signs of error rate dropping in us-west: api.gateway.errors-> 18%.

tim: support: saw immediate drop in new tickets for 2 major accounts after failover. still some plays.

ashwin: CF updated: rollback applied to SNI rules at 14:28 UTC, but propagation to all POPs is staggered. CF recommends keeping failover until 100% edges healthy.

jess: ok. please track customer list impacted and update support banner.

maria: applied banner: "We are investigating intermittent API errors affecting US-West regions. Mitigation in progress; some requests may see intermittent failures."

ashwin: enabling origin bypass for a small percent of traffic to relieve errors for enterprise customers. command: `origin-bypass enable --route /v1/enterprise --percent 10`

observa-bot: origin bypass increase shows errors from 18% -> 6% on /v1/enterprise in 5m. overall latency stable.

ashwin: CF now reports 95% of POPs healthy; last observed handshake failures in legacy POPs. continuing monitoring. keeping DNS failover for another 15 minutes.

rotation-sre: on-call handoff in 30m to maria for mitigation watch and postmortem repository entry. ashwin will remain as incident lead for RCA.

tim: support: closing 12 duplicate tickets and updating customers A,B with status. they asked for ETA; told them expect resolution and full rollback within 30m.

ashwin: final check: error rate back to baseline (~1.2%) in us-west. CF confirms full rollback complete at 14:50 UTC. reverting DNS weights to primary=100.

observa-bot: final metrics snapshot: api.gateway.errors(5xx) = 1.4% (baseline), avg p95 latency normal.

jess: thanks team. please file postmortem with timeline, the CF ticket id, mitigation steps (DNS failover + origin bypass), customer impact list, and follow-ups (automatic early detection for SNI propagation anomalies, update runbook).

ashwin: creating postmortem draft, will assign action items. handing off to maria for watch.

maria: taking watch. I'll ping once I've validated all customer confirmations. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved. follow-up: postmortem required.
